name: The Great Outdoors
summary: Beyond city walls, The Great Outdoors teaches you to meet the wild with care. Seasoned travelers begin with a campfire and the habits that make each journey safer.

sections.title: Lessons of the Trail
sections.body: A sharp blade or potent magic will not save you if you neglect the basics. Near roadside clearings, seasoned wanderers teach travelers leaving their home valleys to rest by a campfire. Its warmth eases sore boots, settles the mind, and prepares you for the harsh road ahead. Rest and preparation improve your chance of surviving long enough to find fortune and glory.

sections.title: A Home Away from Home
sections.body: Your instructors also send you to town tradesfolk, because a field camp needs more than an ember and a bedroll. You can forge replacement rivets, cook trail rations, or stitch torn gear beneath the stars. Each profession offers camp fixtures that help turn a bare hillside into a self-sufficient outpost.

faq.q: Who offers this lesson to new wanderers?
faq.answer: Veteran travelers teach the lesson, though the instructor depends on where you are. In Elwynn Forest, Sam Sarsaparilla teaches it; elsewhere, instructors include Eric Brighthammer, Lyreena Duskblade, Brakk, Eleanor Shackleton, Kaga Wildhoof, and Raan Wildwind.

faq.q: What is the purpose of sitting by the campfire?
faq.answer: Resting by a campfire lets you catch your breath and gain a Boosted Rest effect. Taking time to rest in the field helps you keep your strength on long journeys through the wilds.

faq.q: Where does this training lead next?
faq.answer: After you rest by the fire, your mentor sends you to nearby settlements to learn practical tradeskills. Then you can learn Camping 101: Cooking and field camping lessons suited to your chosen profession.

faq.q: Can Horde adventurers undertake this lesson as well?
faq.answer: Yes. Survival matters to adventurers of either faction. Alliance and Horde instructors, including Brakk, Eleanor Shackleton, and Kaga Wildhoof, teach the same basic campcraft to their initiates.

faq.q: Why do the instructors tell you to speak with trade trainers?
faq.answer: Survival takes more than sitting by the fire; you also need self-reliance. Tradeskill trainers teach you to make camp fixtures for your trade, whether you cook trail rations, mend armor, or brew remedies beneath the open sky.

faq.q: What prior experience is expected before taking this quest?
aliases: how do i unlock great outdoors
faq.answer: You typically receive this lesson after 'The Adventurer', once you have shown basic ambition and left your starter enclave for the wider region.

angles.text: Every wilderness camp begins with fire, so cooking belongs beside outdoor survival. After this lesson, your instructors direct you to cooking lessons along the trail.
In Elwynn Forest, human travelers learn survival basics from experienced wayfarers before facing harsher threats in Westfall and Redridge.
Across Durotar's arid plains and Mulgore's windswept mesas, Horde survivalists teach young warriors firecraft and discipline outdoors.
